name: Voxel DDA Raymarching with Midpoint Interpolation
definition: A ray marching technique for smooth terrain that uses voxel corner heights to compute midpoint surface heights, then linearly interpolates ray intersections along the ray's UV coordinates.
summary: Voxel DDA Raymarching with Midpoint Interpolation is a ray-terrain intersection technique that refines surface height calculations within a single voxel using midpoint geometry, balancing traversal speed and accuracy.
